risks.title: Public misreading as socialism
risks.description: Messaging could be read as endorsing state ownership despite property protections.
risks.mitigation: Use explicit system comparison and property commitments.

risks.title: Public misreading as status-quo capitalism
risks.description: The framework could appear to rename existing shareholder capitalism.
risks.mitigation: State operational distinctions and unresolved mechanisms.

risks.title: Declaration overclaiming without sources
risks.description: Normative or empirical claims may be presented as settled fact.
risks.mitigation: Maintain claim ledger and publication gate.

risks.title: “We” language implies unauthorized collective
risks.description: Collective voice may imply a constituency has adopted the declaration.
risks.mitigation: Use authorial or provisional language until formal adoption.

risks.title: International overgeneralization from American examples
risks.description: US institutional examples could be mistaken for universal prescriptions.
risks.mitigation: Label examples as contextual and retain adaptability principle.
